stem: Give scientific reason: The popularity of probiotic products is increasing.
solution: Probiotic products (like certain yoghurts and fermented milk) contain beneficial live microorganisms such as Lactobacillus. These microbes maintain and restore the useful microflora of the intestine, help in digestion, improve absorption of nutrients, increase immunity and protect against harmful microbes (especially after a course of antibiotics). Because of these health benefits, the popularity of probiotic products is increasing.

stem: Give scientific reason: Body temperature of reptiles is not constant.
solution: Reptiles are cold-blooded (poikilothermic / ectothermic) animals. They do not possess an efficient internal mechanism to regulate and maintain a constant body temperature. Therefore their body temperature changes with the temperature of the surrounding environment, i.e. it is not constant.

stem: Give scientific reason: Nowadays farmers are opting for organic farming.
solution: In organic farming, chemical fertilizers and chemical pesticides are avoided and biofertilizers (e.g. Rhizobium, Azotobacter) and biopesticides are used instead. This keeps the soil fertile and its useful microflora intact, avoids pollution of soil and water, produces chemical-residue-free (safe) food and is eco-friendly. Because it protects health and the environment while maintaining soil fertility, farmers nowadays are opting for organic farming.

stem: What is meant by carbon dating? Give any one use of this technique.
solution: Carbon dating is a technique used to determine the age of fossils and ancient organic remains by measuring the amount of the radioactive isotope carbon-14 (\(C^{14}\)) still present in them. Use: It is used to estimate the age of fossils, which provides evidence for the study of evolution (also used to date archaeological objects).

| Sr. No. | Protein | Name of Organ |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | ____________ | Bones |
| 2 | Insulin | ____________ |
solution:
The completed table is:

| Sr. No. | Protein | Name of Organ |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Collagen | Bones |
| 2 | Insulin | Pancreas |

Collagen is the structural protein of bones, and insulin is the protein hormone secreted by the pancreas.

context: Read the paragraph and answer the questions: Paddy is cultivated on large scale in various states of South India. Paddy fields are frequently attacked by grasshoppers. Similarly, frogs are also present in large number in the mud of paddy fields, to feed upon grasshoppers, and snakes are also present therein to feed upon their favourite food - frogs. However, if frog population declines all of a sudden,
stem: What will be the effect on paddy crop?
solution: If the frog population declines suddenly, the grasshoppers (which the frogs used to eat) are no longer controlled and their number increases greatly. These grasshoppers feed on the paddy plants, so the paddy crop will be badly damaged and its yield will decrease (the crop may be destroyed).

context: Read the paragraph and answer the questions: Paddy is cultivated on large scale in various states of South India. Paddy fields are frequently attacked by grasshoppers. Similarly, frogs are also present in large number in the mud of paddy fields, to feed upon grasshoppers, and snakes are also present therein to feed upon their favourite food - frogs. However, if frog population declines all of a sudden,
stem: Number of which components will increase?
solution: The number of grasshoppers will increase, because their predator (the frog) has declined and no longer controls them. (At the same time the number of snakes will decrease, as they lose their food, the frogs.)

stem: Write any two advantages of hydroelectric power generation.
solution: Any two advantages of hydroelectric power generation: (1) It uses flowing/stored water, which is a renewable and clean source, so there is no air pollution and no fuel cost. (2) The same water can be used again for irrigation and drinking, and the dam also helps in flood control; the running cost is low and power generation is continuous.

stem: The following are the pictures of some disasters. How will your post-disaster management be, in case you face any of those disasters? (A) Gas / chemical leak  (B) Storm / flood.
solution: (A) Gas / chemical leak: Cover the nose and mouth with a wet cloth, move quickly to an open area against the wind, evacuate people from the affected zone, give first aid and shift the affected to hospital, and immediately inform the fire brigade and disaster-control authorities. (B) Storm / flood: Shift people and animals to safe higher places or relief camps, provide clean drinking water, food and medicines, give first aid, help in rescue and rehabilitation, and restore essential services once the disaster is over.
